Third-party notices

Source: THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md

hydrofabric is licensed under Apache-2.0 (© 2025-2026 Lynker Corporation). That license applies to the copyright holder’s own code in this repository.

This package depends on third-party R packages that carry their own licenses. Those packages are not redistributed with this source; they are installed separately from CRAN (or their upstream source) by the end user, so their licenses govern the user’s use of those packages, independent of the Apache-2.0 grant here. Several are copyleft (GPL/LGPL/MPL); using hydrofabric requires installing them and complying with their terms.

This notice is provided for transparency and to answer reuse questions; it adds no constraint to the Apache-2.0 grant on this repository’s code.

Notes for redistributors

  • The copyleft licenses above (GPL/LGPL/MPL) impose obligations on distribution of those packages. Distributing hydrofabric’s own source does not redistribute them. If you bundle these dependencies into a combined distribution (e.g. a Docker image or a vendored archive), comply with each package’s license for that distribution.
  • sf and data.table offer permissive options (sf: MIT; data.table: MPL-2.0, which is file-level copyleft only).
  • This list reflects runtime dependencies. Build and test tooling (knitr, rmarkdown, testthat, withr) is declared in Suggests and is not loaded by the pipeline, so it does not travel with a distribution of this code and is out of scope here.
  • Transitive dependencies carry their own licenses; standard CRAN tooling resolves them at install time.

Data

The data this pipeline produces is licensed separately, under CC BY-SA 4.0. The attribution each domain requires is in NOTICE, and every product carries it in its own metadata.
